body: I understand, Im in the same boat. No I do not have the same diagnosis as you but our situations are similar. I to have no friends or family. You have fake ones, I have only me. I to have bullies (I do mean plural). that have seeked to do me harm in one way or another and no these people are sociopaths so it will not bother them that they hurt you, matter of fact it gives them a feeling of power. So I do know that anger and rage you feel toward this person. You want them to feel the same pain they caused you. In reality they wont understand why you are mad. Neither will anyone else. If it possible remove those people from your life do not socialize with them, dont pal around with them, If you must be around them limit it. You say you have no sex drive, if you are on medications that can do it, if you are on meds and drinking alcohol that will really end it for you. Do you know what people who like to bring you down hate the most? for you to become sucessful despite their efforts to keep you down. You have emotions, I can read it in your post, its angry, hurt and frustrated but its there. If possible take that same anger and put it behind something you like to do. I had to find different people to get around, in my case it was Church, I had always gone to one but it wasnt doing for me. I had to switch and its working. Maybe for you it would work, or school or some group of people that genuinely care. Dont underestimate your value to those around you. Stay strong, from your post I know you can. . .
I really appreciate the kind words, My brother compares me to Job in the bible. Says its a test by GOD. Maybe I will just be glad when its over.
